item_short_desc: Stay safe and visible with Rothco's Security 5-Point Breakaway Safety Vest, designed for optimal protection in any environment. Crafted from durable polyester fabric, this uniform vest features 2-inch wide reflective tape strategically placed across the chest, waist, and shoulders, ensuring maximum visibility in low-light conditions. The innovative 5-point breakaway design is equipped with hook & loop closures along the front, sides, and shoulders, providing an extra layer of safety.
description: Stay safe and visible with Rothco's Security 5-Point Breakaway Safety Vest, designed for optimal protection in any environment. Crafted from durable polyester fabric, this uniform vest features 2-inch wide reflective tape strategically placed across the chest, waist, and shoulders, ensuring maximum visibility in low-light conditions. The innovative 5-point breakaway design is equipped with hook & loop closures along the front, sides, and shoulders, providing an extra layer of safety by allowing the vest to tear away in case of emergencies. Whether you’re working in security, construction, or any other high-risk job, this safety vest is an essential part of your gear. Lightweight and durable, Rothco’s Security 5-Point Breakaway Safety Vest is built to last and ensures that you are always seen and protected.Standard fits S to XL, 2XL / 3XL size available.
